name: autouniverse
description: Auto Universe — PWA ekosistem za auto industriju (Garage + Driver Toolbox). Capacitor za Android APK, isti vanilla JS kod za PWA i native.

scripts.cap:sync:garage: npm run build:garage && cd mobile/garage && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:driver: npm run build:driver && cd mobile/driver && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:open:garage: cd mobile/garage && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:open:driver: cd mobile/driver && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:apk:garage: npm run cap:sync:garage && cd mobile/garage/android && .\gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:apk:driver: npm run cap:sync:driver && cd mobile/driver/android && .\gradlew assembleDebug

author: Milan Plocic (Belora Ventures Studio)
